Vector2 Rotate

Source: R/raymath_functions.R
vector2_rotate.Rd

Vector2 Rotate

Usage

vector2_rotate(v, angle)

Arguments

v

A numeric vector of length 2.

angle

A number.

Value

A numeric vector of length 2

See also

Other vector2 functions: vector2_add(), vector2_add_value(), vector2_angle(), vector2_clamp(), vector2_clamp_value(), vector2_cross_product(), vector2_distance(), vector2_distance_sqr(), vector2_divide(), vector2_dot_product(), vector2_equals(), vector2_invert(), vector2_length(), vector2_length_sqr(), vector2_lerp(), vector2_line_angle(), vector2_max(), vector2_min(), vector2_move_towards(), vector2_multiply(), vector2_negate(), vector2_normalize(), vector2_one(), vector2_reflect(), vector2_refract(), vector2_scale(), vector2_subtract(), vector2_subtract_value(), vector2_transform(), vector2_zero()

Examples

vector2_rotate(c(100, 100), 0.0)
#>   x   y 
#> 100 100
